A '''sonic probe''' was a piece of sensor equipment that the forces of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal]] used during the [[Battle of Mindor]]. In [[44 ABY]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] [[Theran Listener]] [[Listener-Master|Master]] [[Taru Durn]] had also sonic probe among his examination instruments.<ref name="som" />
